_comment_crons: Vercel Hobby allows crons at most once/day, so the */5 drain made every PRODUCTION deploy fail (previews ignore crons). Daily here is an interim reclaim safety net only — the real periodic drain moves to the Coolify worker daemon (docs/infra/coolify-migration-plan-2026-06.md). Remove this block entirely at Vercel decommission. The post-POST inline waitUntil drain still runs every ingest; this cron only catches stalled/reclaimable jobs.
